text: Code reviews are an essential part of modern software development. When developers review each other's code before it is merged, they can catch bugs early, which saves time and money later. Code reviews also support knowledge sharing, because team members learn different approaches and understand parts of the project they might not work on themselves. In addition, regular reviews help maintain team quality by keeping the code clean and consistent. Although code reviews take extra effort, they are a valuable investment. In short, they improve the product and make the whole team stronger.
